#1206 |

INTRODATS
APRIL IS, 2026

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the B3-1 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-K in the area bounded by

West Lawrence Avenue; North Kedvale Avenue; the alley next south of
and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; a line 97 feet west of and parallel
to North Kedvale Avenue

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4133-35 West Lawrence Avenue
